crr.name: Cross River Rail
crr.mapnote: The teal line is the tunnel route. Shaded areas are the work sites as mapped in OpenStreetMap; circles mark stations where no site boundary is mapped.
overview: Cross River Rail is a new 10.2 km rail line with 5.9 km of twin tunnels under the Brisbane River and CBD, and four new underground stations: Boggo Road, Woolloongabba, Albert Street and Roma Street.

The program also rebuilds stations from Dutton Park to Salisbury, upgrades Exhibition station, adds three new Gold Coast line stations (Pimpama, Hope Island and Merrimac), builds train stabling at Clapham Yard and Mayne Yard, and installs a new signalling system (European Train Control System).
It gives the rail network a second river crossing through the CBD, with capacity to run as many as 24 trains in each direction.

Timing and cost, as most recently published by the Queensland Government: first passenger services through the tunnels are expected in 2029, and the total cost to complete the project and associated works is $19.041 billion (October 2025).
Delivered by the Cross River Rail Delivery Authority, with Queensland Rail and Translink (Department of Transport and Main Roads).

wave.name: The Wave
wave.sub: Department of Transport and Main Roads
wave.mapnote: Shaded blue is the rail corridor and station precincts traced from TMR's corridor alignment maps; dashed lines are approximate (between map pages that couldn't be placed exactly, and the metro route beyond Mountain Creek, which is still being investigated).
overview: The Wave is the Queensland Government's planned public transport link for the Sunshine Coast, announced on 25 March 2025 as part of the Brisbane 2032 Delivery Plan.

Stages 1 and 2 (rail): a new passenger rail line from Beerwah to Birtinya, previously called the Direct Sunshine Coast Rail Line. Stage 1 runs 19 km from Beerwah to Caloundra and Stage 2 about 7 km on to Birtinya. It joins the North Coast Line north of Beerwah, so trains continue to Moreton Bay and the Brisbane CBD.

Stage 3 (metro): a high-frequency, metro-style service from the Sunshine Coast University Hospital in Birtinya to Sunshine Coast Airport, via Mountain Creek and the Maroochydore CBD. The vehicle hasn't been chosen yet.
The Mooloolah River Interchange Upgrade is part of The Wave, with a new Mooloolah River crossing linking Kawana Way to the Sunshine Motorway.

Timing and funding as published by TMR: the Australian and Queensland governments have each committed $2.75 billion to Stage 1; Stage 2 construction is subject to funding. Rail construction is expected to start in 2027, subject to approvals, and no opening date has been given. For Stage 3, major construction is planned from 2027, with the corridor operating by 2032.

sites.name: Rail corridor, Beerwah to Birtinya
sites.about: About 26 km of new dual-track rail: 19 km from Beerwah to Caloundra (Stage 1) and about 7 km from Caloundra to Birtinya (Stage 2). It generally follows the corridor protected in 2001 by the Caboolture to Maroochydore Corridor Study (CAMCOS). TMR's maps show about 7 km of viaduct between Bells Creek (Aura) and Caloundra, and a proposed 1.2 km tunnel at Little Mountain between Caloundra West and Aroona.
sites.approxnote: Traced from TMR's corridor alignment maps (September 2025). Where a map page couldn't be placed exactly, the corridor is joined with a dashed line.

sites.name: Beerwah
sites.about: The existing station is to be upgraded with an additional platform, with public access through the station between Beerwah Parade and Simpson Street. TMR has also published designs for a train stabling facility and an elevated rail structure north of the station.

sites.name: Bells Creek (Aura)
sites.about: A new station and town centre precinct at the southern end of the viaduct section, between Aura Boulevard and Bells Creek Arterial Road.
sites.approxnote: Placed between Aura Boulevard and Bells Creek Arterial Road as shown on TMR's map 9, because that map page couldn't be placed exactly; the circle isn't the precinct's boundary.

sites.name: Caloundra
sites.about: A new station by Caloundra Road and Pelican Waters Boulevard, where Stage 1 ends. TMR's map shows the rail passing over Caloundra Road (no level crossing) and possible road upgrades at Pelican Waters Boulevard, Enterprise Street and Marks Road.

sites.name: Aroona
sites.about: A new Stage 2 station near Parklands Boulevard, just after the proposed Little Mountain tunnel between Caloundra West and Aroona.

sites.name: Birtinya
sites.kind: New station: end of the rail line, start of the metro
sites.about: The end of the rail line (Stage 2) and an interchange with the Stage 3 metro.
status: Birtinya station is proposed to be on Station Road, with main access from The Avenue. A tree-lined boulevard will link the Birtinya rail station to The Wave – Stage 3 (Metro).

sites.name: Metro corridor, Birtinya to the airport
sites.about: A dedicated high-frequency corridor from the Sunshine Coast University Hospital in Birtinya to Sunshine Coast Airport, via Mountain Creek and the Maroochydore CBD. TMR released corridor alignment maps for Birtinya to Mountain Creek in June 2026; the section from Mountain Creek to the airport is still being investigated and is shown dashed.
sites.approxnote: Traced from TMR's Stage 3 overview map, so the line is approximate; north of Mountain Creek it's indicative only.

sites.name: Sunshine Coast University Hospital
sites.about: A critical healthcare hub, the Sunshine Coast University Hospital station precinct will not only improve connectivity for patients, staff and visitors, but also ease traffic congestion in the area.

sites.name: Mountain Creek
sites.about: Conveniently located near local schools and TAFE, this precinct will provide easy access and improved connectivity for the community.

sites.name: Maroochydore CBD
sites.about: Investigations into the corridor alignment and station precinct location for the Maroochydore CBD are ongoing.

sites.name: Sunshine Coast Airport
sites.about: Investigations into the corridor alignment and station location precinct for the Sunshine Coast Airport are ongoing.

sites.name: Mooloolah River Interchange Upgrade
sites.about: The MRI Upgrade is a critical part of The Wave and will facilitate seamless access from Kawana Way through to the Sunshine Motorway via a new Mooloolah River Crossing.

sites.name: Kawana Way river crossing
sites.about: A new four lane river crossing with two lanes each way and a dedicated public transport corridor for The Wave Stage 3 (Metro) will significantly improve traffic flow.

sites.name: Kawana Way and Kawana Island Boulevard
sites.about: The duplication of Kawana Way will improve traffic flow, complemented by an upgrade to the Kawana Island Boulevard intersection to enhance connectivity.
